name: Togekko Ji
reason: Togekko-ji is a small Zen temple in Tancos, Portugal, not a person: its own site (togekkoji.org, robots.txt allows us) publishes luar@togekkoji.org and a contact form, but names no resident teacher and shows no photo of anyone (only artwork and landscape images; the Dharma talks are by a visiting teacher, Alcio Braz), so there is no usable photo and no teacher to list.
